This receipt pins the approved content by sha256 digest and byte count. Full-text repository archival of the approved documents is deferred: their text uses vocabulary the retired-vocabulary deny-list (brand-residue gate) blocks for new files, and the approved plan itself schedules deny-list carve-outs at Wave 1; landing the full text before that carve-out would require growing signed-off debt, which this bootstrap step refuses. The plan-store location is provenance narrative only, never an evidence anchor.
